input.title: Give the quantity input the accessible name "Quantity"
input.rationale: The number input #qty has no accessible name. The visible <label>Quantity</label> on line 11 has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the input, so the two aren't linked. Screen readers announce the field only as a spin button. I can only edit the element at this offset, so this patch adds aria-label="Quantity" to the input. That matches the visible label text, so the spoken name and the visible name stay the same, which helps voice-control users. A better fix in the source would be to add for="qty" to the existing <label>. Then the visible label is linked directly, and clicking it moves focus to the field. If the reviewer makes that change, this aria-label isn't needed. This patch fixes the missing label on this field. It doesn't mean the page meets any accessibility standard.
